title: DataContract
description: Output of data-discovery; input to data-pipeline. Describes target tables grounded in real source objects: mappings, grain, tests, bounded/redacted samples, and per-mapping confidence. A human review gate sits between this artifact and pipeline generation -- see references/toolkit-conventions.md.

contract_id.description: Stable identifier across re-runs for the same target (e.g. hash of target table names), so a new run's diff can be matched to a previous one.

invocation_mode.description: greenfield: input was prose business intent, discovery explored broadly for candidate sources. resolution: input was a model-spec from data-modeling, discovery resolved the already-designed target against real objects.

source_model_spec_ref.description: Required (non-null) when invocation_mode is resolution. Points at the model-spec artifact this contract resolves.

grain_determination.description: How grain was established for this contract as a whole. Per-table grain detail lives under tables[].grain.

confidence_basis.description: Reference to contracts/confidence-rubric.md category this determination corresponds to.

statement.description: One row per <X>, in plain language.

confidence.description: Required (non-null) when determination is an inferred category per confidence-rubric.md; null when explicit_constraint or profiled_unique_key (those are measured, not inferred).

basis.description: Evidence behind the grain determination. Required whenever confidence is present, per confidence-rubric.md.

source_joins.description: Non-null only when this table's columns are sourced from more than one source object. Declares exactly how those objects join, as a structured, equality-only condition set -- never a raw boolean SQL expression -- so `data-pipeline`'s `build_transform_spec.py` can render a real multi-table SELECT for a genuine many-to-one lookup join (a denormalizing dimension join, a header-to-line rollup, a dimension surrogate-key lookup) without guessing at a join it was never told. A target with columns from multiple source objects and a null/absent source_joins is refused by build_transform_spec.py, not silently single-sourced -- see skills/data-pipeline/references/other-modalities.md. A join that can't be expressed as an equality condition (a range join, a fan-out-risk one-to-many, anything needing aggregation) has no home in this field at all, by design -- that is exactly the signal transform_complexity: complex_procedural should key off, per skills/data-pipeline/references/decision-rubric.md.

driving_object.description: catalog.schema.table -- the grain-defining source object. Matches the source.object of every column whose source.join_alias equals driving_alias.

alias.description: Unique among driving_alias and every other joins[].alias in this table -- lets the same object (e.g. a self-joined lookup table) appear more than once with distinct column provenance.

join_type.description: left: preserves every driving-side row even with no match (the common lookup-join case). inner: drops unmatched rows -- use only when a human/discovery has confirmed every driving row is expected to match.

on.description: AND-ed equality conditions. Composite-key joins declare more than one item.

left_alias.description: driving_alias or an earlier-declared joins[].alias this condition's left side reads from. Required unless left_expression is given and is unambiguous about which alias(es) it reads.

left_column.description: Exactly one of left_column/left_expression must be present.

left_expression.description: A bare SQL expression over already-declared aliases' columns (e.g. 'CAST(header.OrderDate AS DATE)') for a join key that needs a cast/derivation, not a plain column -- same free-text-SQL precedent as columns[].source.transformation. Exactly one of left_column/left_expression must be present. No trailing SQL comment, same rule as source.transformation (kimball-concepts.md).

right_column.description: A column on THIS join's own object (never another alias's) -- the side being newly introduced.

pii_tag.description: Sensitivity tag from toolkit.yaml, if any. Drives redaction in sample_records and in anything sent to an LLM.

scd_type.description: Carried verbatim from model-spec.json's dimensions[].attributes[].scd_type during resolution mode; null in greenfield mode or for fact columns. data-pipeline only knows how to render type 2 (declarative_pipeline modality); a non-null, non-2 value is carried for documentation but does not change generated code.

join_alias.description: Which of the table's source_joins.driving_alias or source_joins.joins[].alias this column actually comes from. Required (non-null) on every column of a table that declares source_joins; must be null/absent on a table that doesn't -- single-source tables need no alias at all.

mapping_type.description: explicit_alias and name_and_type_match are measured (deterministic). llm_inferred requires a confidence score per confidence-rubric.md.

basis.description: Required when mapping_type is llm_inferred: what evidence grounded the inference.

transformation.description: A SQL expression to compute this column from source.object's columns (e.g. 'DATEDIFF(check_out, check_in)'), or null for a plain rename. Carried from model-spec.json's source_to_target_mappings[].transformation during resolution mode (its 'direct' sentinel translates to null here); may also be set directly in greenfield mode when a plain rename can't satisfy the target's declared type. data-pipeline renders this verbatim as a Spark SQL expression -- never invents one.

source_type.description: The source column's actual profiled/declared type (discovery_findings.json's declared_type), independent of what mapping_type says about the mapping's confidence. Lets data-pipeline catch a declared target type that doesn't match reality and no transformation present, rather than silently rendering a bare alias that will fail or misbehave at runtime.

threshold_basis.description: profiled: threshold derived from observed data (e.g. observed min/max, observed null rate). explicit_constraint: read off a real PK/FK/NOT NULL/CHECK constraint. default_convention: no evidence available, toolkit default applied -- must also appear in assumptions[].

sample_records.description: Bounded, redacted example rows. Sensitive columns (per toolkit.yaml) are hashed or redacted, never raw. Capped at the sample size configured in toolkit.yaml.

unresolved_requirements.description: resolution mode only: anything in the source model-spec that discovery could NOT satisfy against real objects. Never silently dropped.

assumptions.description: Every inference this artifact makes, with its basis. Never silent.
